system.name: Soul
system.one_liner: a full-system realization of GCP-based synchronization atop MIND, a disaggregated shared-memory platform, providing standard lock APIs across compute blades

components.name: Applications
components.role: user programs that call standard lock APIs

components.name: Lock library (§4.4)
components.role: user-space shim exposing standard lock APIs atop Soul's GCP implementation

components.name: Lock manager (§4.5)
components.role: in-kernel manager sitting between the lock library and the DRAM cache controller, allocating GCP cache resources

components.name: GCP-extended DRAM cache controller (§4.2, §4.3)
components.role: kernel component implementing GCP's wait queue and shared memory lists over MIND's DRAM cache coherence

components.name: GCP-extended cache directory (§4.2, §4.3)
components.role: switch-side counterpart implementing GCP's cache-coherence directory

components.name: Control Plane
components.role: control-plane band of the programmable switch, relaying GCP transactions to memory blades

components.name: Memory blades
components.role: disaggregated memory reached over GCP transactions through the switch

content.key_idea: Soul places a GCP-extended DRAM cache controller in each compute blade's kernel, coordinated over GCP transactions with a GCP-extended cache directory inside a programmable switch's data-plane ASIC, which also relays transactions to memory blades.
content.reading_order: Top-down within Compute blades (Applications to Lock library to Lock manager to cache controller), then left-right via GCP Txns. to the switch and up to Memory blades.

summary: This figure shows the full-system architecture of Soul, which realizes GCP-based cache-coherent synchronization atop the MIND disaggregated shared-memory platform. On each compute blade, applications call standard lock APIs into a user-space Lock library, which talks over GCP interfaces to an in-kernel Lock manager sitting atop a GCP-extended DRAM cache controller; that controller exchanges GCP transactions with a matching GCP-extended cache directory inside a programmable switch's data-plane ASIC, whose control plane in turn relays GCP transactions to memory blades. The diagram is a flat, square-cornered box diagram split into a host side (Compute blades: user space over OS kernel) and a device side (Programmable Switch: control plane over data-plane ASIC), with blue fill picking out the GCP-specific components on both sides of the transaction boundary.
summary_zh: 该图展示 Soul 系统架构：计算刀片上应用经用户态锁库、内核态锁管理器，调用 GCP 扩展 DRAM 缓存控制器；该控制器与可编程交换机数据面 ASIC 中的 GCP 扩展缓存目录交换 GCP 事务，交换机控制面再将事务转发给内存刀片。
